description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactService class, which provides high-level operations for managing emergency contact data for employees in the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations and search functionality.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactService
classes.description: Service class that manages employee emergency contact data, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and search emergency contacts.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Data Access Object (DAO) for employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object, typically for dependency injection or testing.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specified employee.

methods.name: saveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves an emergency contact record for an employee.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes one or more emergency contacts for an employee, or all if sequence numbers are not provided.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Performs a search for emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching the search filter.
